content.text: {"conditions":{"rc1":{"status":"gap","note":"The Agency's conclusion that Complainant \"failed to prove\" discrimination or reprisal is stated without any steps linking the testimony to it, and the narrative under claim (1) (the ND-05 Manager/A42 Branch Head selection) does not match the listed claim (1) (being chastised for professional development courses)."},"rc2":{"status":"review","note":"Most characterizations are tied to named roles (S1, S2, S3, PM1-PM3, Complainant), but no report-of-investigation exhibits, interview scores or DEMO benchmark documents are cited, and the closing statement that the cybersecurity classes were awarded in a prior EEO complaint has no identified source."},"rc3":{"status":"review","note":"Dates are given for the complaint (January 4, 2019), the Group Lead email (December 3 and 20, 2018), the DEMO notices (December 11 and 17, 2018; January 30, 2019), but the vacancy interview dates, the counseling during the year, the FAD date and the prior EEO activity are undated, and the numbering of the claims is out of order."},"rc4":{"status":"review","note":"Reviewers and criteria are partly documented (panel members, S2, S3 as selecting official, HR-vetted questions, Group Lead assessment factors), but the DEMO threshold, the basis of S3's reconsideration finding (\"adequately compensated\") and the reasoning behind the FAD are not recorded."},"rc5":{"status":"gap","note":"An independent reviewer could not assess whether the FAD conclusion is supported without outside context, given the claim mismatch, missing underlying documents and the absent reasoning between testimony and conclusion."}},"remediation_note":"The record would need the claim statements aligned with their narratives, cited source exhibits (ROI testimony, interview scoring, DEMO benchmarks and S3's reconsideration findings), a dated chronology including the vacancy process, counseling and FAD issuance, and the Agency's stated reasoning linking the evidence to its conclusion."}
